Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  August 16, 2023

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on August 16, 2023.
Commissioner Metcalf called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

  Present:  Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Jacques
  Lesure - Commissioner at Large, Commissioner Phyllis Battle ‐
  District 3, Commissioner, Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks -
  District 4

  Absent:  None

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Sabrina Barnes  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. Ms. Wendy, a member from the audience asked what became of
the Swaps statue that was located at Hollywood Park Racetrack. Jason Witt, Sr., Director
Affairs and Engagement at Hollywood Park stated it is currently in storage.

SPECIAL PRESENTATION. Jason Witt, Sr., Director of Community Affairs and Engagement
at Hollywood Park gave an art plan update.

STAFF REPORTS. Roots Wall-mounted Sculpture at Inglewood Senior Center. Staff report
recommending the Arts Commission recommend the Mayor and Council accession Roots,
a work of public art by Pontus Willfors, into the City of Inglewood Public Art Collection,
making it eligible for maintenance and conservation through Public Art Fund allocations
(Public Art Fund). The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Lesure, Battle, Banks, and Metcalf
Noes: None

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  1. Public Art Conservation: The Written Word and History of Transportation, October
  2023.
  2. CA Historic Preservation: Doors Open 2023: Civic Center Art Tour on September 9.

  1
   Arts Commission

PUBLIC REMARKS. Gregg Spero from the Tiny Room Studios located at 6819 West
Boulevard introduced himself and briefly spoke about his studio and nonprofit
organization. Lynnette Astaire from Superfood School introduced herself and talked little
about the her company and the programming they offer.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Next Arts Commission meeting on September 20, 2023 at 6:30 p.m.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Metcalf declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:12 p.m.
